New CEC, commissioners pay homage to Liberation War martyrs
2022-03-01T11:36:32+06:00 | Star Digital Report
https://www.thedailystar.net/news/bangladesh/news/new-cec-commissioners-pay-homage-liberation-war-martyrs-2973126

Newly appointed Chief Election Commissioner Kazi Habibul Awal today paid tributes to the martyred freedom fighters at National Memorial in Savar, on the outskirts of Dhaka.

The CEC placed wreaths at the memorial at 10:10am, reports our Savar correspondent.

The four election commissioners -- Rashida Sultana, Brig Gen (retd) Ahsan Habib Khan, Md Alamgir, and Anisur Rahman – were also present there.

They observed a one-minute silence at the memorial.

Later, the CEC and commissioners signed the visiting book there and started for Dhaka around 10:30am.

President Abdul Hamid appointed the CEC and four election commissioners on February 26.
